description.value: Pallet Coffee Roasters is a Vancouver-based specialty coffee roastery running eight cafe locations across the city, with this outlet on Howe Street in the heart of downtown. The brand is focused on single-origin specialty coffees roasted in-house, served alongside a food menu and freshly baked goods. The Howe Street location sits in a pedestrian zone, making it a natural pause point for cyclists moving through the downtown core.
